relationships.subject: Peritoneal macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: Peritoneal macrophages in women with endometriosis have increased mRNA expression of the cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), which resulted in increased prostaglandin secretion [64].

key_findings: Review of endometriosis epidemiology, pathogenesis and genetics; chronic inflammation with macrophage cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta) and COX-2.
VEGF is elevated in peritoneal fluid of endometriosis patients and correlates with disease stage.
